title: integration-orchestration-checkin-2026-11-29
content:
Meeting: Solutions Eng + ProServices weekly orchestration check-in
Date: 2026-11-29 10:00 PT
Facilitator: Aisha Patel
Attendees: Marco, Grace, Omar, Leah, customer Liaisons (Atlas PMs via async notes)
Purpose: quick health check across active integrations, call out escalations before EOW, confirm next-week windows for restricted network changes

High-level summary
- Overall pace steady; three active integrations with rolling cutovers this month.
- Biggest active risk remains private-networking changes for BlueForge and delayed cert rotation for NimbusCommerce.
- New item: AtlasPay requested an additional schema validation step for tool-calling outputs causing extra integration work (see Actions).

Customer-by-customer snapshot
1) AstraCove - staging -> canary expected next Tue 12/02
   - Status: final QA on schema mappings in staging. Quick tokenization mismatch found on long prompts (edge-case with custom tokenizer).
   - Blocker: model variant 4q-int8 behaves slightly differently for newline handling; product wants parity with hosted API.
   - Mitigation: Grace to run small regression suite against hosted baseline (target: 11/30). If diff > threshold, fallback plan to 16-bit variant for canary.
   - ETA: canary rollout 12/02 morning, 4-hour monitoring window.

2) BlueForge - private deployment (on-prem w/ VPC)
   - Status: network team scheduled firewall rule changes but gating on expired customer TLS cert. Customer security has freeze window Wed 11/30 - Thu 12/01.
   - Blocker: cert rotation requires on-call CA admin; currently queued with customer. Without cert we can't finish service mesh join.
   - Workaround: provision a temporary reverse-proxy in edge subnet for smoke tests, but will not be production-available.
   - Action: Omar to confirm CA admin availability and share exact rotation steps by EOD 11/30. If not available, schedule proxy fallback and document limitations.

3) NimbusCommerce - hosted -> dedicated transition
   - Status: data residency requirements triggered additional logging/audit hooks. Dedicated infra team needs to enable KMS integration and S3 endpoint whitelisting.
   - Blocker: KMS key policy false-positive in internal audit causing delay (security flagged missing tag).
   - Note: latency SLO target tightened; must run baseline perf with quantized model settings.
   - Action: Marco to run perf harness with quantized config and upload results to linked artifact (RDW-4789) by 12/01. Security to re-run tag check after fix.

Cross-cutting technical items
- Tool-calling schema validation: AtlasPay asked for additional typed field checks upstream; means we need a lightweight schema gate in the router before sending to model. Impact: +40-80ms per request if done synchronously.
  - Discussion: acceptable for most customers, but for low-latency customers we should offer async validation or sampled validation.
  - Action: Leah to prototype async validation thunk and measure impact. Prototype due 12/03.

- KV cache warming for long-tail prompts
  - Observed: AstraCove and NimbusCommerce workloads show high variance in prefix reuse; small cache warming routine could reduce cold-start token costs by ~12%.
  - Action: Grace to draft config toggle for prefix prefetch and propose opt-in under Redwood Optimize for private/dedicated customers. Draft by 12/07.

- Quantization regressions
  - Example: AstraCove newline/tokenization diffs between 4q-int8 and 16-bit. We need an automated delta tracker per rollout.
  - Action: Add delta-check job to CI that compares new quantized variant against baseline on a small eval set (owner: Marco). Target: integrate into pre-canary pipeline 12/09.

Risks & severity (red/amber/green)
- BlueForge cert rotation: RED (high) - stops production join. Owner: Omar. Mitigation: proxy fallback, escalate to customer security.
- NimbusCommerce KMS policy: AMBER - delays dedicated spin up by 1-3 days. Owner: Marco with SecOps.
- AtlasPay schema gate latency: AMBER - requires design decision on sync vs async validation. Owner: Leah.

Open questions / items to escalate to Eng leadership
- Can we accept transient +80ms for schema validation for all paid tiers and only optimize low-latency tier later? Need product POV from PMs by 12/01.
- Should we prioritize delta-check CI for quantized variants now or defer until after Q4 cutover? Impact on rollout cadence.

Action items (owner - due)
- Grace Kim - regression run vs hosted baseline for AstraCove newline diffs - due 2026-11-30
- Omar Hussein - confirm CA admin availability & rotation steps for BlueForge - due 2026-11-30
- Marco Diaz - perf harness quantized config + upload results to RDW-4789 - due 2026-12-01
- Leah Brooks - prototype async schema validation thunk + initial perf measurement - due 2026-12-03
- Aisha Patel - coordinate EOW readiness call and confirm canary windows with customers - due 2026-11-30
- Engineering leadership - decision on schema validation tradeoff (PM sign-off) - requested by 2026-12-01

Notes to self / meeting fragments
- Consider adding a lightweight sampling mode for full schema checks to reduce customer risk without adding full latency tax.
- Remember to add Canary rollback playbook link to the runbook before 12/02.
- Customer ask: BlueForge wants end-to-end test summary in plain-English for their security board - keep it short, include cert lifecycle steps and access controls.

Next sync
- Same time next week 2026-12-06 10:00 PT; propose ad-hoc for cert rotation if CA admin shows up earlier.

Appendix (quick links and snippets)
- Smoke checklist snippet: node join -> cert verify -> canary traffic split 5% -> monitor token error rates and latency -> expand 20% -> full.
- Quick troubleshooting tip: if KV cache shows hit rate < 5% after join, trigger prefix prefetch and re-run sample workload.

End of notes
